name: Beginners American Mahjong (BAM!)
description: American Mahjong beginner classes and guided play based in Scripps Ranch, with sessions offered throughout San Diego from Downtown to Carlsbad.
schedule: 3-lesson beginner class series (afternoon 1-3:30pm or evening 6-8:30pm slots); separate Guided Play sessions for class graduates; custom classes available at your home/office/clubhouse.

name: Coastal Mahjong Club of San Diego
description: Weekly American Mahjong (NMJL) open play group meeting at venues across San Diego's North Coast — Del Mar, Carmel Valley, Encinitas, and La Jolla.
schedule: Weekly sessions rotating across North Coast venues; drop-in $12/session or $32/month unlimited; bring current NMJL card or buy one on-site ($15); new players should message ahead for an intro session.
